recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38000 unless a work group later wants to revise the semantics of DocumentReference.version in a new issue.
issue_request: FHIR-38000 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for DocumentReference to allow a document version, because Composition had gained Composition.version and the old composition-clinicaldocument-versionNumber extension did not apply to DocumentReference. OO's final decision was to adopt a Composition-like version element with DocumentReference-specific wording.
initial_application: Commit 5493ce6532e563d2c9cba54155c56a4edfa11ebc, titled "close FHIR-3800", added DocumentReference.version to source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml and added a DocumentReference-version search parameter. Commit e41db687b398699cf93fb3dff28b80d554c9c311 corrected that search parameter's URL, and commit 0567b321121d035aeefc71f3508017e34d7efdbb added the reciprocal Composition.version mapping to DocumentReference.version.
additional_context: DocumentReference and Composition are active approved resources in source/fhir.ini. Structured Documents issues FHIR-34407 and FHIR-38201 removed the old Composition ClinicalDocument version extension/profile because Composition.version replaced its meaningful contribution. The Extension Pack keeps composition-clinicaldocument-versionNumber only as a version-specific extension through FHIR 4.3. OO minutes from 2022-10-18 record the vote to add a DocumentReference element mirroring Composition.version, and a 2025 implementers Zulip thread confirms that the Jira intent was alignment with Composition.version.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active DocumentReference structure definition already has DocumentReference.version as a 0..1 string with isSummary=true and mappings to Composition.version and FiveWs.version, and the active DocumentReference search parameter bundle exposes version with expression DocumentReference.version.

related_jiras.note: Original Composition versionNumber request that led to the ClinicalDocument version extension before Composition.version existed.
Structured Documents removed the ClinicalDocument profile/extension because Composition.version replaced its meaningful contribution.
Structured Documents explicitly removed the Composition versionNumber extension as unnecessary in R5/R6.
